name: SKPL Season 2
description:
Skull Crushers were the story of the regular season, going unbeaten with wins over Leo Legends, Flag Smugglers, and Chaos Crew to finish top of the table, with Chaos Crew close behind in 2nd. In the playoffs, Skull Crushers cruised past Chaos Crew 6–1 in the Qualifier to book a direct Final spot, while Chaos Crew kept their title hopes alive by beating Leo Legends 6–2 in the Eliminator. That set up a Qualifier rematch in the Final — and this time Chaos Crew turned the tables, beating Skull Crushers 6–4 to be crowned SKPL Season 2 champions.

Chaos Crew's Darshan was central to that turnaround, delivering when it mattered most through the Eliminator and Final to be named Season MVP.

name: SKPL Season 1
description:
Smash Karts Premier League's inaugural season launched with four teams — Leo Legends, Skull Crushers, Chaos Crew, and Flag Smugglers — battling it out in a competitive Team Capture the Flag format. Across a series of intense regular-season clashes, Chaos Crew emerged as the league's most consistent side, while Flag Smugglers' speed-focused roster proved impossible to contain in the closing stretch. The two sides met in a winner-takes-all Final, where Flag Smugglers held their nerve to be crowned SKPL's first-ever champions.

Leo Legends' Aman set the standard the league would chase for years to come, earning the inaugural Season MVP award.

name: SKPL Season 3
description:
Season 3 trimmed the league to three teams — Skull Crushers, Chaos Crew, and Leo Lions — playing a double round-robin before a straight shootout for the title. Chaos Crew were untouchable through the regular season, winning all four of their games, while Leo Lions did just enough to edge out Skull Crushers for the other Final spot. The two sides met again with everything on the line, and Chaos Crew closed it out 6–4 to be crowned SKPL Season 3 champions.

Chaitanya was the league's most lethal player by a wide margin, topping the kill charts all season and starring again in the Final — but it was Leo Lions' Aman, a model of consistency across every match and twice named Player of the Match, who took home the Season MVP award.
